title: Update root CLAUDE.md ROADMAP and workspace docs for gf2-algebra
description:
Update root `CLAUDE.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, and the workspace-level documentation to reference the new `gf2-algebra` crate (epic success criterion 11).

## Background

The new crate is the third Rust crate in the workspace; the root `CLAUDE.md` §Architecture section lists `gf2-core`, `gf2-coding`, `gf2-kernels-simd`, `gf2-kernels-hip`, and `proofs/` — `gf2-algebra` must be added. The `ROADMAP.md` must reference the epic and the headline outcomes. This is the closing-leaf issue of W7.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] Root `CLAUDE.md` §Architecture lists `gf2-algebra` with a one-paragraph description of its scope and the modules it hosts (`packed/`, `permanent/`, `gpu/`).
- [ ] [hard] Root `CLAUDE.md` §Commands includes the `gf2-algebra`-specific test/bench/example invocations.
- [ ] [hard] `ROADMAP.md` references the gf2-algebra-permanent epic outcomes (50× speedup, F_5/F_7 generalisations, GPU prototype, Lean V1/V2 verification).
- [ ] [hard] Any project-level workspace docs (`docs/`, top-level READMEs) that enumerate crates are updated.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass (in case any markdown is referenced from rustdoc).
